exceptional_censuses.completeness: The projective four-root census contains every coefficient vector with fibre at least four. Every omitted vector has fibre cap three and hence S6<=18.

nonclaims: The prime-uniform S6 theorem is not yet proved.
A uniform fibre cap five is false: p=199 and p=419 have isolated six-fibres.
No extension-field, arbitrary-background, whole-ImgFib, or list-grand conclusion is claimed.

parity_quotient.even_support_identity: For Gamma(X)=sum_(j=1)^5 c_j X^(2j), put P(Z)=sum c_j Z^j. On X=r xi, Z=X^2 ranges over r^2 H and Gamma(X)=P(Z).
parity_quotient.exact_envelope_identity: S_(2h)(Gamma)=2*S_h(P restricted to Q^2), where Q=F_p^*/H and Q^2 is the image of the squaring map
parity_quotient.odd_support_identity: For Gamma(X)=X sum_(j=0)^4 c_j X^(2j), put Z=X^2. Since Z^6=r^11 X and Z^11=r^22 on r^2 H, inversion W=Z^-1 gives Gamma(X)=r^11 sum_(j=0)^4 c_j W^(5-j).
parity_quotient.quotient_map: rH maps to r^2H or r^-2H with kernel {H,-H}
parity_quotient.reduced_polynomial: P(Z)=c_1 Z+...+c_5 Z^5 with every c_j nonzero, evaluated on the square quotient cosets Q^2 inside F_p^*/H.
parity_quotient.target_at_h_3: S_6(Gamma)<=20 iff S_3(P restricted to Q^2)<=10

proved_reduction: All geometrically available characteristics in which a six-point fibre can occur satisfy exact S6<=20. In every other characteristic the fibre cap is five. Parity supports reduce exactly to the full-degree-five top-three bound on Q^2, S3(P|Q^2)<=10.
remaining_global_obligations: For gap-gcd one supports outside p=199,419, prove S6<=21 by the projective line-orbit incidence theorem or give a counterexample.
For the two parity supports, prove the reduced quintic-coset theorem S3(P|Q^2)<=10 or give a counterexample.

six_fibre_table.proof: A six-point fibre makes the 6x6 Fourier evaluation matrix on exponents {0} union A singular. Affine changes of exponents and roots reduce all cells to the displayed exact table. Outside the listed prime divisors every determinant remains nonzero.

diagonal_label_multiplicity.proof: Two quotient labels rH and sH give the same projective coefficient point exactly when (r/s)^(a-a0)=1 for every active exponent. The kernel has size gcd(A-A); H has odd order 11, so the gcd-two kernel is represented by H and -H.
